helpText: The main responsibility of a converter is to convert the payload from one type to another e.g. JSON to XML - it returns a new object, so the output type can differ from the input type. This is the key difference from a Translator, which changes the payload's content in place while keeping its type unchanged.
allowableProperties_comment: Note that the order of properties in this file dictates the order displayed on screen, unless propertyDisplayOrder is set, which will be used as the primary key

description.helpText: A more detailed description of the component that may assist in support.
